strategies.title: ReUI Integration
strategies.content: ReUI registered as on-demand remote MCP server at https://mcp.reui.io with official skill in .agents/skills/reui and /reui workflow.

strategies.title: CI Pipefail Enforcement
strategies.content: Always set -e -o pipefail in CI bash scripts when piping build tools (flutter build, gradle) to tee to prevent masked failures and missing artifact distribution errors.
